name: pxlpeep-browser
description: Dev tooling only. The extension itself has zero dependencies and no build step; nothing here is shipped.

scripts.check: npm run check:js && npm run check:manifest
scripts.check:js: node --check content/main.js && node --check content/takeover.js && node --check content/desktop.js && node --check background/worker.js && node --check viewer.js
scripts.version: node scripts/stamp-version.js && git add manifest.json src-tauri/tauri.conf.json src-tauri/Cargo.toml content/main.js
